Preparation:
  H_RNP="$(mktemp -d)"; chmod 700 "$H_RNP"
  H_GPG="$(mktemp -d)"; chmod 700 "$H_GPG"

  rnpkeys --homedir H_RNP \
      --import ../keys/bob@openpgp.example-0xfbfcc82a015e7330-pub.asc
  rnpkeys --homedir H_RNP \
      --import ../keys/bob@openpgp.example-0xfbfcc82a015e7330-secret.asc

  GNUPGHOME=H_GPG gpg --batch --quiet \
      --import ../keys/bob@openpgp.example-0xfbfcc82a015e7330-pub.asc
